_help: Act 1, encounter A: Harold Finch and his enforcer Musa Kamal think you know where Freddie is. Talk your way out (owe_finch, or freddie_betrayed with the note), pay 20 of Freddie's 200, which only buys time (debt_paid_part, and 50 more owed: owe_finch), or provoke a fight: event fight_debt_collectors (end_fight; the brawl tutorial), after which act1_after_brawl. End ids end_talked / end_paid / end_fight. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act1.py.

start.speaker: finch
start.line: There he is. Freddie Mallory's old army pal. Freddie owes me two hundred pounds, and I think you know where he is.

choices.label: Say you don't know
choices.line: I don't know. He owes me money too.

choices.label: Promise to pay
choices.line: I'll have work soon. I'll pay you part of his debt from it.

choices.label: Pay part now
choices.line: Here's twenty pounds. Call it interest. Now leave me alone.

choices.label: Insult him
choices.line: Get out of my way, Finch, before your bruiser needs a doctor.

dont_know.speaker: finch
dont_know.line: Then you're no use to me. Unless you'd like to pay his debts, being such good friends.

betray.speaker: finch
betray.line: Alexandria. There, that wasn't hard. Come on, Musa. We've a train to catch.

promise.speaker: finch
promise.line: Part of it. From work you don't have. All right, soldier, I'll hold you to that. Fifty pounds within the month.

paid.speaker: finch
paid.line: Twenty. Of two hundred. That buys you a week, soldier, not a pardon. Fifty more within the month, or Musa comes back.
